title: Gremlins
tagline: Three rules. Dinner breaks none of them.
about: A boy gets a strange little creature for Christmas and breaks every one of the rules.
cue: Serve the snacks well before midnight.
faces: THREE RULES. DINNER BREAKS NONE OF THEM.
Open 4 pm to midnight, not Mondays.

Dredge the chicken twice.Fry in the oil at 165°C in batches until 75°C at the bone.Serve well before midnight.Kingston Falls gingerbreadGinger and cinnamon gingerbread cut into little shapesHow to make it125g butter100g brown sugar100g golden syrup300g plain flour2 tsp ground ginger1 tsp cinnamon1/2 tsp bicarb soda200g icing sugarMelt the butter, sugar and golden syrup, then stir in the flour, ground ginger, cinnamon and bicarb.Chill the dough.Roll out and cut into little houses.Bake at 180°C until firm.Cool, then pipe with icing made from the icing sugar and a little water.Mrs Peltzer's blender smoothie shotsMrs Peltzer fights back with the blender and the microwaveHow to make itNot on tonight's cookFrozen berries, banana and Greek yoghurt blitzed thick with honey, poured into little shot glasses with a swirl of berry sauce down the side.Simmer 100g frozen berries with 1 tbsp sugar for 5 minutes and cool for the sauce.Blend 300g frozen mixed berries, 1 banana, 250g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp honey and 200ml milk until thick and smooth.Drizzle a little sauce down the inside of 12 shot glasses, pour in the smoothie and serve straight away with tiny spoons.Hot pretzels with honey mustardKate's tray. Peel and chop the potatoes.Brown the mince with the onion and carrot.Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and stock and simmer.Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.Top the mince with mash and bake at 200°C until golden.SweetsSnow White cupcakesVanilla cupcakes with a fluffy meringue frosting rolled in coconutHow to make it125g butter300g caster sugar4 eggs200g self-raising flour50ml water100g desiccated coconutBeat the butter with half the sugar, add 2 eggs and the flour and spoon into 12 cupcake cases.Bake at 175°C until risen and golden, then cool.Whisk the 2 remaining egg whites, boil the rest of the sugar with the water to 118°C and pour in while beating until thick.Dome the meringue on each cupcake and roll in coconut.DrinksRule two sparkling citrus coolerLemon, lime and orange with mint and elderflower in sparkling waterHow to make it1 lemon2 limes1 orange1 bunch mint60ml elderflower cordial1 L sparkling watercrushed ice, to serveSlice the lemon, one lime and the orange into thin wheels.Lightly crush a handful of mint with the cordial and the juice of the other lime in a jug.Add the citrus wheels and sparkling water.Fill four glasses with crushed ice and pour over.
